Existing operators running the documented `disqus:import -c <category>` workflow get an 'unknown option' failure or topics created in the default category with no way to set one; this is unrelated scope drift bundled into an embed PR.

adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` the `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` is removed and the related `category_id` lookup logic is deleted. The import path is changed to `TopicEmbed.import_remote(...)`, and neither `import_remote` nor `TopicEmbed.import` accepts/sets a category (they call `PostCreator.new` without any `category`/`category_id` option). This is a backward-incompatible change that will cause existing `disqus:import -c <category>` invocations to fail with an unknown option and removes previously supported functionality.
